## Shared scenes

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) notices [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) unexpectedly leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) in his finest clothes, sparking her curiosity. She visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate and learns from [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that they are adopting an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) on the farm. Mrs. Rachel expresses strong disapproval and warns [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) of the risks involved before departing to spread the news.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

> [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is shocked to discover that an orphan girl was sent instead of a boy. Upon realizing she is unwanted, [Anne](../character/anne.md) breaks down in tears, introduces herself, and insists on spelling her name with an 'E'. After a brief, uneventful supper, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) puts [Anne](../character/anne.md) to bed in the east gable room, before discussing with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) down in the kitchen how to return her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne.md) up to bed and instructs her on keeping her room tidy and saying her bedtime prayers. Upon learning that [Anne](../character/anne.md) has never said a prayer, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prompts her to invent one, resulting in an unconventional prayer from [Anne](../character/anne.md). Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes down to the kitchen and tells [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) that they must properly educate and raise the girl.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

> After [Anne](../character/anne.md) refuses to leave her room or eat, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) secretly visits her and gently convinces her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) to smooth things over. [Anne](../character/anne.md) dramatic apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who forgives her completely and offers her hope about her hair color. Walking back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels an unaccustomed warmth toward [Anne](../character/anne.md) as the young girl expresses her happiness at finally having a home.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne.md) for putting wild flowers on her hat, but then brings her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/di.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) quickly hit it off in the garden, solemnly vowing to be best friends forever. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) a package of chocolate sweets, bringing her immense joy.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) suspects [Anne](../character/anne.md) of taking her missing amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. Desperate to attend the upcoming picnic, [Anne](../character/anne.md) fabricates a dramatic story about losing the brooch in the water, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway as punishment. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her own lace shawl, apologizes to [Anne](../character/anne.md), and quickly sends her off to enjoy the picnic.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovers that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has won the medal and she has won the Avery scholarship at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). After commencement, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), reunites with [Diana](../character/diana.md), and learns about Gilbert's plans and Matthew's declining health. She enjoys a peaceful day outdoors and has a tender evening conversation with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) suddenly dies from shock after reading news of the Abbey Bank failure, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) in deep grief. Neighbors come to offer support, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) gradually processes her loss through tears and conversation with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). Later, as life begins to resume its normal routine, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sit together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) discussing future plans and Marilla's past relationship with John Blythe.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose playful and rowdy behavior immediately poses a challenge for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md). At church on Sunday, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) creates a commotion by dropping a caterpillar down [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) White's neck during the service. Later in the week, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruins Dora's dress by forcing her to walk the pigpen fence and pumps water over her, subsequently confessing to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he also hid a toad in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) completes her school year and walks home, meeting young [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) on her way to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) cemetery. They discuss their loved ones, imagination, and placing flowers on graves. At the cemetery, [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and the two walk home together while discussing teaching, ideals, friendship, and future plans.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation
